verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and API platform. A built-in assistant, for example in its dashboard or docs, is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes APIs, models, tools exposed to external agents (MCP, edit_file) and an API 'Try it' runner. None of these is a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to inside Morph.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
